episode.title: The Real Reason Britain Called Napoleon Short

synopsis: Napoleon Bonaparte was average height for his time, but enemy wartime propaganda successfully skewed public perception.
narration: Napoleon Bonaparte was not short; he stood five feet six inches, average height for nineteenth-century Frenchmen. British wartime caricatures spun his imperial guard's tall stature into political propaganda, creating a myth that outlasted his empire.
